sentences.text: HC-KAR CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition with liberty to challenge the charge sheet.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL The Petitioner above named pray that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow the petitioner to withdraw the above petition with a liberty to challenge the charge sheet though this Hon'ble court was pleased to stay the further investigation.
but the Respondent has filed charge sheet.
hence with a liberty the matter would be withdraw in the interest of Justice.

"
2. Liberty so sought is granted.
In terms of memo, the petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
